Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using a tandem tag (moTAP) to isolate the LTβR signaling complex. While the paper discusses linear ubiquitination (M1-AP), the primary LC-MS/MS dataset (PXD034142) described in the methods and PRIDE metadata is the AP-MS of the complex, not a remnant-motif enrichment (like diGly or QQTGG) for the mass spec search. Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the primary modifier.

scope: we purified the native LTβR-SC via two sequential affinity purification steps (one FLAG- and one Streptag-based) before performing liquid chromatography-coupled tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) on the resulting purified native LTβR-SC.

While linear ubiquitination is a central biological theme, the MS data described for the PXD034142 dataset is a standard AP-MS protein abundance analysis rather than a site-specific ubiquitome search.
